achievements.name: Armies of Ruin
achievements.detail: Clear The Armies of Ruin, the opening battle of Legend Mode.

achievements.name: Adventure Map
achievements.detail: Win a battle on the Adventure Map.

achievements.name: Linkle Joins
achievements.detail: Finish the third Legend Mode scenario and recruit Linkle.

achievements.name: Giant Boss
achievements.detail: Defeat a giant boss such as King Dodongo during a battle.

achievements.name: A Rank
achievements.detail: Finish any mission with an A rank.

achievements.name: Gold Skulltula
achievements.detail: Defeat a Gold Skulltula that appears during a mission.

achievements.name: Item Card
achievements.detail: Use an Item Card to uncover a secret on an Adventure Map square.

achievements.name: My Fairy
achievements.detail: Break jars in an Adventure Map keep and recruit a companion fairy.

achievements.name: Weapon Tier
achievements.detail: Obtain a higher weapon tier for any warrior.

achievements.name: Master Sword
achievements.detail: Acquire the Master Sword in the Temple of the Sacred Sword.

achievements.name: Legend Complete
achievements.detail: Defeat Ganondorf in Liberation of the Triforce and finish Legend Mode.

achievements.name: Ganon's Fury
achievements.detail: Clear Ganon's Fury in Challenge Mode.
